decisions.reason: The accelerator program was still on the home page in both years and costs the growing firm little to run, so it has no shortfall that would prompt search for other uses of its resources.

The bio-based bitumen binder sits far from the core machinery business and showed no reported traction, but the firm's growth and investment give it enough slack to keep carrying this uncertain, R&D-heavy product.
The infectious waste decontamination plant was featured prominently in both years as a partnership flagship and appears to meet aspirations, so there is no reason to search for alternatives.
